study: Murphy, Roschelle, Feng & Mason 2020 (Maine ASSISTments online-homework RCT, JREE 13(2); ERIC ED657283)
delivery_evidence: Teacher PD was a genuine mix: a two-day in-person summer training (plus a second summer in-person session) AND an additional day of technical assistance distributed across the school year via webinars, email, and in-person visits (Teacher Professional Development section, p.~? ; 'a single two-day summer training and an additional day of technical assistance distributed across the school year via webinars, email, and in-person visits').
test_alignment_evidence: Sole included outcome is the TerraNova mathematics scale score, a standardized nationally-normed assessment independent of the ASSISTments content; extraction test_type=standardized_independent (p.255; Table 7, p.256).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting the ASSISTments online math-homework software platform (delivers homework problems with immediate student feedback and nightly teacher reports); the PD/coaching exists 'to support its use'; control = business-as-usual homework (Method; 'access to ASSISTments and teacher professional development to support its use').
outcome_timing_evidence: TerraNova administered in the spring of the second (end) implementation year, immediately post-intervention; no post-treatment follow-up wave (Method; extraction timepoint 'post, end of 2nd implementation year').
